description: Replace n=8192-32768 fixed 4096-panel left-looking loop with communication-avoiding recursive lower-only Cholesky. Factor compact base tiles, perform tensor-core TRSM/SYRK with SM100 CuTe/tcgen05 FP32 accumulation, keep the next diagonal resident, remove explicit full triangular inverses and n-squared half workspaces, and schedule lookahead within a single compliant stream.

Removed n>=16384 explicit 4096x4096 inverse formation and solve GEMM; use direct cuBLAS TRSM for every tall panel and allocate no inverse, identity, or solved-panel workspaces. Full validation passed; large-shape means n8192=4453.624 us, n16384=14234.329 us, n32768=52329.746 us.

Replaced the n-squared FP16 factor workspace with in-place FP32 factors and a separately compiled SM100 CuTe/tcgen05 TF32 left-looking update; eliminated panel conversion. Full validation and all benchmark checks passed. Target means n8192=4509.282 us, n16384=14887.884 us, n32768=58733.891 us; TF32 traffic/update cost regressed the direct-TRSM predecessor.

Implemented a single-stream recursive 4096-wide TRSM: 1024 base solves plus SM100 CuTe/tcgen05 TF32 remainder GEMMs against the compact column-major factor, with no explicit inverse. Full benchmark correctness passed. Target means n8192=4512.601 us, n16384=15029.309 us, n32768=60539.500 us; the three TF32 solve updates cost more than direct TRSM on this path.

Collapsed the recursive root into one cuSOLVER POTRF base using FP32-emulated-BF16x9 math, eliminating all panel/inverse/half/update workspaces and launches. Full correctness passed, but target means were n8192=6069.876 us, n16384=32922.137 us, n32768=136117.783 us, confirming a large full POTRF is far slower than panelized tcgen05 updates.

Replaced recursive solve GEMMs with FP16-input/FP32-accumulate tcgen05 updates, using one 4096x4096 transposed factor cache and O(n*2048) solved-panel scratch; no inverse and no n-squared half workspace. Full correctness passed. Target means n8192=4535.345 us, n16384=15005.613 us, n32768=60248.541 us; FP16 updates recovered 291 us at n32768 versus recursive TF32 but factor conversion/base TRSM launches remain costly.

Stored transposed FP16 solved panels in unused physical upper-triangle bytes of the FP32 output, added coalesced transpose-convert packing, and performed blockwise SM100 tcgen05 outer updates before clearing upper storage at return. No n-squared auxiliary half cache; recursive half TRSM retained. Full correctness passed. Target means n8192=4637.851 us, n16384=15085.798 us, n32768=56289.138 us, recovering 3.96 ms at n32768 versus separate-scratch recursive path.

Compacted the no-inverse recursive solve to two 2048 TRSM leaves and one FP16/tcgen05 update, converting only the needed 2048x2048 off-diagonal factor quadrant rather than the full 4096 square. Full correctness passed. Target means n8192=4646.871 us, n16384=15053.649 us, n32768=56183.805 us; targeted movement was within noise but reduced factor traffic and launches.

Replaced library TRSM leaves with one persistent CTA per 64 panel rows: each CTA traverses all 64 factor tiles, uses MathDx FP16/FP32 block updates and device triangular solves, and stores directly to the lower panel on the current stream. Full correctness passed. Target means n8192=11812.015 us, n16384=39679.104 us, n32768=139960.620 us; 2016 small MathDx updates and repeated factor traffic per CTA overwhelm the added parallelism.

Replaced narrow left-looking/packed updates with lower-only right-looking recursion: copy the lower input once, recursively solve each panel without a full inverse, convert into reusable O(n*4096) half scratch, and launch one large triangular SM100 tcgen05 SYRK per stage. Full correctness passed. Target means n8192=4436.850 us, n16384=14079.373 us, n32768=51739.952 us, recovering 4.44 ms at n32768 versus the compact recursive left-looking path.

Replaced 2048 direct-TRSM leaves with compact 2048 inverse-plus-tcgen05 GEMM leaves inside the no-full-inverse recursive solve, using reusable O(n*2048) FP32 scratch and retaining FP16 cross-half updates plus lower-only right-looking SYRK. Full validation and all benchmark checks passed. Target means n8192=4647.652 us, n16384=12228.075 us, n32768=36528.978 us.

Profile-driven recursive 4096 POTRF: two 2048 cuSOLVER factors, compact inverse/tcgen05 solve of the off-diagonal quadrant, FP16 lower-only tcgen05 rank-k, and strided factor assembly. Full correctness passed. Target means n8192=6063.712 us, n16384=15055.252 us, n32768=42202.082 us; the strided 2048 factors plus assembly/update overhead exceeded the monolithic 4096 POTRF despite its low occupancy.

Moved both recursive 2048 POTRF leaves into compact column-major lda=2048 buffers and assembled only the three lower quadrants into the 4096 factor. Full correctness passed. Target means n8192=6110.634 us, n16384=15159.876 us, n32768=42372.679 us; compact leading dimensions did not recover the recursive factor overhead.

Restored the profiled monolithic 4096 POTRF and selected direct cuBLAS TRSM for recursive tail panels of at most 4096 rows, while retaining compact inverse/tcgen05 leaves for taller panels and lower-only right-looking rank-k. Full correctness passed. Target means improved to n8192=4429.579 us, n16384=12008.706 us, n32768=36367.713 us; aggregate 724.140 us moved with unrelated-cell noise.

Replaced cuSOLVER 4096 POTRF with the validated 64x64 MathDx wavefront: four micro-panels per 256 supernode, device triangular solves, and triangular tcgen05 rank-k directly in each compact factor buffer. Full correctness passed. Target means n8192=6761.644 us, n16384=14642.305 us, n32768=38857.417 us; hundreds of uncaptured current-stream launches dominate and create high variance despite faster device work.

Captured the complete fixed-pointer large-shape MathDx factor wavefront, compact recursive solve, and triangular update DAG after warmup, replaying it as one compliant current-stream CUDA graph. Full correctness passed. Target means improved versus uncaptured MathDx to n8192=4745.675 us, n16384=12507.065 us, n32768=38034.563 us, but remained slower and substantially noisier than the monolithic-factor donor.

Preferred large-shape donor 96be23f43abd103dc13f7ebd3229d1715b939be8: full-grid 724.140 us; n8192=4429.579 us, n16384=12008.706 us, n32768=36367.713 us. Explored direct/recursive TRSM, TF32 and FP16 tcgen05 updates, output-upper packed panels, lower-only right-looking SYRK, compact inverse leaves, recursive POTRF, persistent MathDx solve/factor, and CUDA-graph replay. Hosted profile shows 4096 cuSOLVER POTRF at 2.38 ms with 12.36% occupancy; open directions include a fused/cooperative 4096 factor base, graph-safe wavefront with fewer launches, and lookahead overlap.
